cv.name: Grace Pemberton
cv.headline: Senior Marketing Manager | B2B SaaS & Healthcare | Former Journalist
cv.summary: Marketer who started as a newspaper reporter and moved into content marketing in 2017. Has since built and led demand generation and brand programs for fintech, consumer and digital health companies, now managing a team of six.

experience.title: Senior Marketing Manager
bullets: Own the B2B marketing plan targeting employers and health plans, with a $2.8M annual budget
Lead a team of six across content, lifecycle and paid media
Launched an account-based program for 150 target accounts; pipeline from these accounts up 41% year over year
Rebuilt the website messaging with product marketing and sales

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Managed email, SMS and paid social for a DTC home brand
Grew the email list from 60k to 210k subscribers

experience.title: Content Marketing Manager
bullets: Built the blog, newsletter and webinar program from scratch for a small fintech SaaS

experience.title: Staff Reporter
bullets: Covered local government and business for print and digital

education.school: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications, Syracuse University
